title: Terrorism, trade, tariffs & wars: What's in India's hard-won Brics declaration
description: The New Delhi Declaration 2026 was unanimously adopted by BRICS nations at their summit.  This declaration emphasizes conflict prevention and the peaceful resolution of international disputes.  BRICS countries also backed stronger multilateralism and expressed concerns over unilateral trade measures.  Prime Minister Modi called for global governance reforms and greater Global South representation.  India is chairing BRICS in 2026 under a theme of resilience and cooperation.

title: Rafale set for major firepower boost as France fast-tracks F5 upgrade amid India’s 114-jet plan

The F5 standard is anticipated to bring substantial upgrades for upcoming missions.

title: NIA raids 10 locations across Jammu & Kashmir in LeT-linked terror conspiracy case
description: The National Investigation Agency conducted searches at ten locations across Jammu and Kashmir. These searches are connected to a cross-border terror conspiracy involving Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba handlers. The agency seized incriminating material relevant to the ongoing investigation into the conspiracy. This investigation began after the arrest of an alleged LeT-linked Over Ground Worker earlier this year. The NIA continues to examine financial and communication trails to identify all involved individuals.

description: Harvard University has alerted international students about significant F-1 and J-1 visa rule changes. New Department of Homeland Security rules replace the duration of status system with fixed visa end dates. Students re-entering the US after September 15 will face stricter limits and new visa frameworks. Those already in the US before this date will generally retain current protections and benefits.

title: Barir Pujos to stick to centuries-old tradition, will have fish for bhog
description: During the vibrant celebration of Durga Puja, Bengal's historic families proudly uphold their tradition of offering non-vegetarian dishes, intertwining their customs with ancestral heritage and devotion. The Sabarna Roy Chowdhury family has a rich history of presenting non-vegetarian bhog that dates back 300 years, while the Sovabazar Rajbari has sacrificed catfish since 1858. The Chorbagan Chatterjee family contributes an array of fish from Saptami to Dashami.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
description: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too
description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
description: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.
